Don’t risk your life or spend your hard-earned money on smugglers’ false promises.

Extreme summer temperatures along the Southwest Border can be deadly.
 
If you cross illegally, you will be arrested, processed, and quickly removed from the United States.

Save your money. Protect your family. Do not make the dangerous journey.

Learn more: https://t.co/6x0nVbLg4n
